name: Chaos Skull
description: A floating humanoid skull animated by scintillating magic.

abilities.name: Levitation
abilities.description: The Skull levitates several feet off the ground and can’t be Restrained.

abilities.name: Wards
abilities.description: The Skull is resistant to magic damage.

abilities.name: Magic Burst
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Skull succeeds against take 2d6+4 magic damage.

abilities.name: Siphon Magic
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a PC with a Spellcast trait within Very Close range. On a success, the target marks 1d4 Stress and the Skull clears that many Stress. Additionally, on a success, the Skull can immediately be spotlighted again.
